qs.s: Le cambrioleur a réussi à ___ un collier en or de la vitrine.

qs.en: A thick curtain makes it possible to hide the kitchen from visitors' view.

qs.s: Quand on lui pose des questions difficiles, il a tendance à se ___ .
qs.en: When asked difficult questions, he tends to evade (dodge them).

qs.en: She dreams of becoming a novelist and publishing her first novel one day.

qs.en: This chef is a true wizard (figuratively) — his dishes enchant every guest.

qs.en: In this adventure film, he plays a powerful and mysterious sorcerer.
